description: Off-the-clock work, unpaid overtime, illegal deductions, last cheque withheld pending return of equipment, tips retained, and cash payment with no record.
energy_note: Worked, and simply not paid for it.

aspect: Recovery costs more than the amount
description: Claiming £600 requires a process longer and more expensive than £600, which the employer knows when deciding whether to pay.
energy_note: Priced just below the cost of making them pay.

aspect: It targets those who cannot complain
description: Migrant workers, people on probation, those paid in cash, and anyone whose status depends on the employer, as in IMM-004.
energy_note: Aimed precisely at whoever cannot report it.

description: 'There was the uniform, and the till was down in July.' Neither was ever raised at the time. It is £340. She has a new job starting Monday and no energy left.
energy_note: Three hundred and forty pounds, and she lets it go.
